about_the_game:
Mowing and Growing, From Clicks to Idle

Double-stick controls, screens full of enemies, and token collection make combat both satisfying and intuitive. As you unlock and upgrade talents, your character grows stronger while your workload lightens—eventually, you won’t even need to aim. Enemies vanish across the screen like CRT white flames, leaving you free to sit back and enjoy the stress-free mowing thrill.

Hundreds of Talents, Growth Full of Surprises

The talent system allows free combinations, with hundreds of skills to boost your power. Leveling up comes with a chance for critical upgrades, sometimes skyrocketing multiple levels at once. Every step of progression brings unexpected delight and a strong sense of achievement.

Pixel Retro Aesthetics and Psychedelic Soundscapes

Minimalist CRT-style pixel visuals paired with psychedelic electronic and jazz-inspired lounge music. From combat rhythm to the explosive visuals of defeated enemies, everything feels like sitting in a cyber café as rain taps gently on the window—your mind and body completely at ease.

Short but Refined Full Experience

With a total playtime of only 3–4 hours, the game is packed with delightful mechanics and over a dozen Steam achievements. No complex puzzles, no hidden levels—just simple, relaxing gameplay that delivers the full experience.

A Dual Therapy of Sight and Control

Watch enemies dissolve in bursts of light, feel the rhythm in every note, and let gameplay and progression form a satisfying loop. Blast Bebop isn’t just a game—it’s a unique journey to unwind and recharge.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible GPU
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

short_description: Blast Bebop is a relaxing incremental idle shooter in a retro CRT pixel world. Unlock powerful talents, level up, and effortlessly mow down enemies while enjoying psychedelic electronic and jazz lounge music—a stress-free cyber café vibe.
supported_languages:
English*, Simplified Chinese*
*languages with full audio support
